help.noRoom: You will see the settings once you are in a room. Defaults are shown below.

rules.1: Every player gets a few cards. You cannot see other players' cards, but you know how many each has.
rules.2: Take turns declaring poker hands you think exist among all the cards on the table, not only in your own hand.
rules.3: On your turn you must either declare a hand strictly higher than the last one, or check it. Passing is not allowed.
rules.4: After a check everyone shows their cards. If the hand is in the pool the checker gets a card, otherwise the declarer does.
rules.5: Whoever reaches the card limit after losing is out of the game. Each new round is started by the next player.
rules.6: The last player left wins. The deck and the order of hands depend on the room settings, see the other tabs.

help.fullRules: The full rules are in the project documentation.
